alignments.note: Nomen rectum with the construct relation recast as a relative clause; the relative belongs to the rectum's unit under rule 19.

Supplied lexical verb for a colon whose Hebrew writes none, and which the Hebrew does not write anywhere in the coordination; `added` under rules 34 and 20.

review_notes: Variant WLC.PRO.20.30.v005 is underdetermined and resolved to r00-base, covering s003; the English permits the fallback, so rule 53 does not apply.
